subject.title: refactor(codex): keep projector no-op cases local

question: Should this related but behavior-neutral Codex cleanup be sponsored for merge, or should the merged diagnostic fix remain without this refactor?
rationale: Repository guidance normally rejects standalone refactor-only PRs, while the protected `maintainer` label indicates that an explicit human decision is required; the code review alone cannot establish that sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the focused cleanup
options.body: Accept it as tightly coupled follow-up work after the contributor adds inspectable redacted runtime proof for the no-op and unknown-notification paths.

options.title: Keep the existing implementation
options.body: Close or defer the refactor if the one-use diagnostic helper is preferred over another merge cycle for no user-visible behavior change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the focused cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept it as tightly coupled follow-up work after the contributor adds inspectable redacted runtime proof for the no-op and unknown-notification paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current cleanup and are the most direct contact for clarifying whether it was requested as follow-up work.
